rationale: On Windows with no registered HostRunLoop, MainThreadScope and MainThreadTimer now fall back to a message-only window on the creating thread (SetTimer and PostMessage), so plug-in editors in hosts that cannot lend a loop still get timers and posts. Windows-only platform-layer change; this is a Pulp-only edit because Vellum's framework transfer is in effect and its editors do not use the platform main-thread layer off Apple. macOS and Linux behaviour is unchanged.
